YesSql.description: Configures the YesSql document store of the tenants. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Data/.

CommandsPageSize.description: The maximum number of commands in a YesSql command page. Larger sets of commands are split into multiple pages.

QueryGatingEnabled.description: Whether identical concurrent queries are coalesced so that YesSql executes them once and shares the result.

EnableThreadSafetyChecks.description: Whether to enable checks that help diagnosing the concurrent use of a YesSql session.

IsolationLevel.description: The default transaction isolation level passed to the database provider.

Data.description: Configures the tenants database access. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Data/.

Sqlite.description: Configures the SQLite database provider. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Data/.

UseConnectionPooling.description: Whether SQLite connections are pooled. Pooled connections can keep the database file open, which may prevent operations such as copying or replacing the file for a backup. Disabling pooling can reduce performance.

TableOptions.description: Defines the table naming presets copied into the tenant settings when a tenant is set up. Changing them later doesn't rename existing tables or alter existing identity columns. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Data/.

DefaultDocumentTable.description: The name of the default YesSql document table.

DefaultTableNameSeparator.description: The separator between a table prefix or collection name and the table name. Use one or more underscores, or 'NULL' for no separator.

DefaultIdentityColumnSize.description: The size of the identity columns.

OrchardCore_YesSql.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_YesSql' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:YesSql' instead.

OrchardCore_Data_Sqlite.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_Data_Sqlite' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:Data:Sqlite' instead.

OrchardCore_Data_TableOptions.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_Data_TableOptions' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:Data:TableOptions' instead.
